regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, two-theme leadership structure in China A-shares: Banks (rank 1, eligible, crowded, broad) and Innovative Pharma & CXO (rank 2, eligible, crowded) sit far above a weak, mostly ineligible field. Crucially, the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false, mean-reverting tape), and the track record shows directional accuracy of only 0.377, so this note is intentionally held to a couple of low-conviction, falsifiable leans rather than a broad view.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Coal (rank 6, eligible, mean-revert tag) can sustain eligibility into a second week — an early sign the leadership structure may broaden beyond the current two crowded financial/health themes; the watch retires if Coal loses eligible status or falls back below rank 8 for two consecutive prints.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the confirmed leader with the highest durability_bar (0.73) and broad participation (breadth 0.889). The trend-gate eligibility and rank-1 score are attention/focus signals, not alpha, and the crowding flag (z=1.78) is a size-down caution only — not a fade. Given the market's documented mean-reverting tape and weak directional track record, I express only a modest conditional lean that leadership persists near-term.
evidence: rotation leader with margin 0.01 over challenger
theses.dissent: Crowding is high and the benchmark tape is mean-reverting; in that regime stretched leaders often stall even without a fundamental break, and the detector's own history shows the trend gate did not cut drawdown here.

falsifier.text: Banks (512800.SS) underperforms the CSI 300 by 4% before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma/CXO is the only credible challenger, nearly tied with Banks (score 0.988 vs 0.998) and also eligible, but its breadth (0.643) is meaningfully narrower and durability lower (0.6). It is crowded as well. With a challenger margin of only 0.01, this is a coexist-and-watch structure, not a confirmed handoff. I lean positive only as a secondary expression contingent on joint leadership holding.
theses.dissent: The near-tie could resolve against Pharma quickly if Banks re-accelerate; Pharma's lower breadth and durability make it the more fragile leg of the two-theme structure, and crowding adds fragility in a mean-reverting tape.

falsifier.text: Pharma/CXO (159992.SZ) underperforms the CSI 300 by 5% and Banks by 3% before the 20-day check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
